notes: Graduation policy (p.7): minimum 24.5 credits, awarded upon demonstration of proficiency; each department has 2-8 discipline-specific proficiencies required for graduation; graduation ceremony requires all 24.5 credits. Credits from other accredited schools are accepted. Required local course structure in the Blue House: English in all four Blue House semesters with 2 English credits in the Blue House (juniors take T.H.E.E. or AP English Language; seniors take Seminar, 0.5 English + 0.5 social studies); social studies in three of four Blue House semesters with 1.5 credits in the Blue House. All students develop a Personal Learning Plan (PLP) grades 9-12 (p.6). Health: one semester required (p.25). PE: three semesters required (p.27). Options credit: up to 2.0 total, elective only (p.10). Schedule: 30-minute Mod 2 block five days a week for Homebase/AT (p.6). The catalog gives no grading scale. Catalog combines the 2026-27 main Program of Studies and the Grade 9 POS.
